resources.string: Turn any local video into a lightweight live wallpaper.
Choose a video stored on your device. Kinewall keeps read access so it can play after a restart.
Choose how the video fills the wallpaper surface.
Fills the entire screen and crops overflowing edges. Drag the video in Android\'s wallpaper preview to choose the visible area.
Fits the video to the screen even if its aspect ratio changes.
If Kinewall is already your live wallpaper, choosing a new video updates it automatically.
Diagnostic logging is optional and disabled by default.
When enabled, Kinewall records app and wallpaper playback events in internal storage. Turning it off stops new log entries.
